phase_gate.reason: The automated audit baseline is established, but manual accessibility and representative-hardware evidence remain required before Phase 8D can be described as complete.

documentation_policy.reason: Repository CI intentionally rejects tracked Markdown; this machine-readable artifact is the tracked Phase 8D status, evidence index, claim-boundary record, and verification handoff.

core_web_vitals_lab.scope: The LCP and CLS lab regression ceilings align with the published good Core Web Vitals thresholds. The 200 ms value is used only as a scripted lab interaction ceiling; this repository does not describe Event Timing samples as field INP.

deterministic_compute.scope: These are repository-enforced deterministic local-compute regression ceilings from the certified Phase 8D performance checkpoint, not network or end-user latency SLAs.

api_in_process.scope: The selected ASGI measurements are reporting-only in-process baselines. They exclude network, reverse-proxy, deployment, and real-user latency; no API latency pass threshold is frozen.

representative_hardware_wwt.scope: The operator tool records WWT WebGL draw-bearing animation-frame cadence. It is not GPU-completion timing and no project cadence floor is frozen; an optional operator floor must be supplied explicitly.

verification_commands.python_static: uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy apps/api/src apps/api/tests scripts/bootstrap scripts/data scripts/openapi scripts/ci

manual_evidence_required.reason: Automated axe, landmarks, focus, contrast, touch, and fallback checks do not prove full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance.
ARIA roles and automated accessibility-tree checks are not equivalent to testing with a real screen reader.
Current automated checks use CSS presentation zoom or equivalent narrow-layout proxies; real browser 200% zoom remains manual.
CPU/network emulation is a synthetic proxy and does not replace representative low-end hardware testing.

Headless Chromium is not representative hardware. The opt-in tool must be run headed against an explicit Lumina URL with real WWT network access; its draw-bearing frame cadence is evidence, not GPU-completion timing or a pass without an explicit floor.
Scripted Event Timing is lab interaction-latency evidence, not field INP/RUM evidence.
DOM/listener cleanup after route leave is automated, but retained GPU/driver memory requires representative-hardware profiling.

claim_boundaries: CSS or viewport reflow proxies are not described as real browser zoom certification.
Automated axe results are not described as screen-reader or WCAG certification.
Scripted lab interaction latency is not described as field INP.
Synthetic CPU/network throttling is not described as representative low-end hardware evidence.
In-process ASGI latency is not described as deployed HTTP, proxy, network, or real-user latency.
WWT draw-bearing animation-frame cadence is not described as GPU-complete frame timing, and representative-hardware eligibility is not described as a performance pass without an explicit floor.
